body: We are Canada's engaged university, defined by our dynamic integration of innovative education, cutting-edge research, and far-reaching community engagement.
We are unconventional, fearless, compassionate, approachable and ready.
We celebrate the diversity of people, ideas and cultures.
Provides managerial and operational support for the undergraduate and graduate programs of the School.
•	Manages the delivery of all academic programs by: (40%)
Representing the department on relevant committees.
Developing work plans and evaluating their effectiveness.
•	Leads staffing and teaching assistant processes (25%)
•	Approves program expenditures within the budget
PROBLEM SOLVING AND LEVEL OF SUPERVISION
•	Escalates policy exceptions to the Director
•	Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related discipline and four years of related experience
•	Ability to work cooperatively with others
•	due to the nature of this position there is a bona fide occupational requirement that the incumbent must have a current satisfactory criminal record check on file
